title: fix(metadata): two Studio Saves over one published item are no longer last-writer-wins
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-alice"} -->
_Requested by **Alice** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01NoziMoftaSPmzgKNjJGePH?thread=cmsg_01NoziMoftaSPmzgKNjJGePHJDtYrcfiNfCiqhM4g8dFWZ)_

Fixes #36601

Clause-②: yes (widening) — two new optional members join what the API accepts and answers: `PublishMetaItemRequestSchema.parentVersion` (the `If-Match` / `If-None-Match: *` pin on `POST /meta/:type/:name/publish`) and `GetMetaItemLayeredResponseSchema.overlayVersion` (served on `GET /meta/:type/:name/layers`); nothing is removed or narrowed, and a publish that names no version behaves as before
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — the two members are REST wire members (a publish precondition and a layered-read answer member) that Studio sends and reads; no metadata author writes them and no published skill teaches the publish route's headers

## 维护者速读

- 在 Studio 对象页，两位管理员同时改同一个已发布对象时，后保存的人不再悄悄覆盖先保存的人，而是看到“你打开之后这里已被修改”，可选重新加载、确认覆盖或继续编辑。
- 属于元数据并发保护：草稿已有版本锁，这次补上“直接发布”这一步，替同时编辑的管理员解决改动丢失。
- 出错的话，最坏是保存时多弹一次冲突对话框或保存被拒；不带版本的旧客户端行为不变，撤回本次合并即可恢复原状。
- 要你做的事：无。

## What changes

**Server (`@objectstack/spec`, `metadata-protocol`, `rest`, `runtime`)**

- `GET /meta/:type/:name/layers` answers `overlayVersion`: the keyed version token of the stored active row at the read's address (`?package=`). It is the same token the plain uncached read serves as `version` and a publish receipt serves as `version`; `null` when no active row is stored there. Opt-in on the protocol (`withVersion`), turned on by the REST route and the runtime meta domain, so in-process layered readers pay no extra read.
- `POST /meta/:type/:name/publish` takes that token as `If-Match`, or `If-None-Match: *` for "no active row here". The headers are parsed by the save door's own parser (`metaSaveRequestOptions`), so the two doors refuse the same malformed preconditions with `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`.
- A stale pin is refused `409 METADATA_CONFLICT` with `currentVersion`, through the existing `metadataConflictRefusal`. Nothing is promoted and the draft stays pending.
- The pin is checked by the store's put lock on the promoting write (`promoteDraft`'s new `expectedActiveHash` becomes the put's `parentVersion`), not by an earlier separate read. The token is converted with the existing `storedParentForToken`.
- A publish with neither header is unpinned, exactly as before.

**Studio (`@object-ui/data-objectstack`, `app-shell`, `i18n`)**

- `MetadataClient.publish` takes `ifMatch` / `ifNoneMatch` and sends them as headers.
- `DraftVersionGuard` holds a second pin per item, for the published row: `recordPublished` (from the load's `/layers` read, via `publishedPinOf`) and `publish` (sends the pin, then holds the receipt's version so one editor's Saves chain).
- On a conflict, the guard asks through the same dialog as a stale draft, with `layer: 'published'` wording ("This changed since you opened it"):
  - **Reload** takes back the draft the Save wrote, then re-reads the live object.
  - **Overwrite**, after a confirmation, re-publishes pinned to the refusal's `currentVersion`. A publish landing in between is asked about again.
  - **Keep editing** publishes nothing, takes back the saved draft, and leaves the edits on the page with the draft conflict's own "Not saved" line.
- `publishSavedItem` takes the guard's publish as an optional `pinned` argument. Overloads keep the unpinned callers' outcome type unchanged.
- Studio's object page (`StudioDesignSurface` data pillar) is wired: its load records the published pin and its Save publishes through it.
- New studio locale keys (en, zh): `engine.draftConflict.publishedTitle`, `publishedDescription`, `publishedOverwriteTitle`, `publishedOverwriteDescription`.

**Not in this PR.** The object extension, hooks, pair-actions and flow editors still publish unpinned, so their behaviour is unchanged. Each needs its own load to read `/layers`. This is reported to the seat as follow-up.

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/meta-item-publish-version-pin.test.ts` (new, real stack: better-sqlite3, cache off). Cases:
  - the unpinned control (last writer wins, as before)
  - two pinned Saves: the second gets `409`, `currentVersion` equals A's receipt and the next `/layers` token, B's draft stays pending, and an overwrite pinned to `currentVersion` is accepted
  - the token agrees across `/layers`, the plain read and the publish receipt
  - a draft-only item serves `null`, its first `If-None-Match: *` publish succeeds and a second is refused
  - a guessed raw token gets `409`
  - two malformed header pairs get `400`
- `DraftConflictDialog.test.tsx`, new describe for the published pin:
  - `publishedPinOf`
  - pin then receipt chaining
  - reload order (publish, then discard, then reload, with pins cleared)
  - overwrite and keep-editing (the kept-editing error is told apart)
  - a `null` pin, and unpinned
- `StudioDesignSurface.draftVersionConflict-11773.test.tsx`, new describe "two Saves over one published object are not last-writer-wins":
  - keep editing
  - reload
  - overwrite
  - one editor's pins chain
  - a server without `overlayVersion` gets an unpinned publish
- Ablation: with the Save's publish unpinned again, 4 of the 5 race cases fail. The control stays green, as it should.

## Acceptance notes

- Ruling ①: the publish answer already served `version` (the active token). The new piece is the read Studio loads from, so `/layers` now answers `overlayVersion`, the same token.
- Ruling ②: the refusal is the typed `409 METADATA_CONFLICT` with `currentVersion`, the draft door's own. Studio shows the draft conflict's reload-or-overwrite dialog, worded for a live change.
- Ruling ③: no header means unpinned. The control test pins today's behaviour.
- Seat ruling on #36511 (no client-only re-read before save): the check is server-side, inside the promoting write's lock.
- Read first, by risk:
  - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-and-publish.ts`: the token-to-hash conversion and the first-write pin passed to `metadataConflictRefusal`.
  - `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/DraftConflictDialog.tsx`: `DraftVersionGuard.publish`, especially the reload ordering.
  - `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studioSaveBar.tsx`: `publishSavedItem`'s `pinned` branch.
- Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-item-publish-version-pin.test.ts` should report 7 passed.

## Verification

Head `263b1dc5`, base `3cf6a44b`; merges cleanly onto current `origin/main` (`overlap-check`: VERDICT clean).

- Premise on main `3cf6a44b`: the unpinned control showed B's publish replacing A's, the publish ignored `If-Match`, and `/layers` served no version.
- Server suites: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 23352 passed / 45 skipped; `@objectstack/rest` 8794 passed / 351 skipped, with 1 failure: an existing assertion on the layered route's options, updated for `withVersion` and re-run green (13 passed in that file); `@objectstack/runtime` 11845 passed / 25 skipped.
- New and neighbouring server files: `meta-item-publish-version-pin`, `meta-item-layered-route`, `meta-item-version-token-occ`: 35 passed.
- UI: `DraftConflictDialog.test.tsx` + `StudioDesignSurface.draftVersionConflict-11773.test.tsx` 41 passed; the 36511 save suites plus `data-objectstack` and `i18n`: 237 files, 3413 passed; `ui/scripts`: 5127 passed.
- Type checks: `spec`, `metadata-protocol`, `rest`, `runtime`, `app-shell` (both tsconfigs), `data-objectstack`, `i18n`: clean.
- Generated: `check:generated --fix` regenerated `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` (committed).
- Derived gate families (`dispatch-gates --ran`): 126 derived, 125 run with exit 0, 1 NOT-MEASURED: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exit 3, its positive control is pinned to a commit this shallow clone cannot reach. Declared to CI. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needs a whole-repo `pnpm build` and is likewise declared to CI.
- Two gates went red on this branch and are fixed in it: `check:facade-delegation-only` (the protocol facade was 10 lines over its ceiling; its layered-read answer type now reuses the facet's declared type, and the file is 30 lines shorter than base) and `check:test-source-alias` (the edited layered-route test pays the engine load at collection).
